property_summary: For every admissible call authorized by the current depositorAccount, setL1BlockValues leaves all L1 block state unwritten, so c.l1FeeOverhead() remains 0 regardless of the fuzzed _l1FeeOverhead; the mutant stores _l1FeeOverhead, breaking this for any call with a non-zero overhead.
change_summary: Insert an assignment that stores _l1FeeOverhead into the state variable l1FeeOverhead, which P never writes.
